description: This file implements security-related utilities for a FastAPI application, including password hashing, JWT token creation and validation, role-based access control, MFA verification, and audit logging.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hashed password using bcrypt.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: dict _jwt_payload(user_id: int, email: str, scopes: list[str])
methods.description: Creates a JWT payload with user ID, email, and scopes.

methods.name: str create_access_token(user_id: int, email: str, scopes: list[str], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Generates a JWT access token with optional expiration.

methods.name: dict decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising HTTPException if invalid or expired.

methods.name: dict get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the provided JWT token.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_current_active_user_optional(token: Optional[str] = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the current user if a valid token is provided.

methods.name: Callable[[dict],Any] rbac_required(required_roles: Optional[List[str]] = None, allow_superuser: bool = True)
methods.description: Dependency generator for role-based access control, enforcing role requirements.

methods.name: bool mfa_verify_code(secret: str, code: str)
methods.description: Verifies a TOTP MFA code using a shared secret.

methods.name: audit_log(session: AsyncSession, action: str, entity_type: Optional[str], entity_id: Optional[str], details: Optional[dict], user_id: Optional[int], request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Creates a tamper-evident audit log entry with hashed chain.
